About the guide

A clearer way to explore local mental health support.

The Treasure Valley Mental Health Guide is designed to make it easier to understand options, compare practical details, and connect with local support without turning the directory into a pay-to-rank marketplace.

What the guide is for

The guide combines a counselor directory with plain-language information about therapy, trauma, PTSD, EMDR, anxiety, grief, psychiatry, crisis support, lower-cost care, and community assistance.

Who it serves

The public-facing guide is built for people across Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Caldwell, and the surrounding Treasure Valley. Providers use a separate portal to maintain their own listing information.

How the directory works

Visitors can narrow results by practical criteria such as specialty, insurance, treatment approach, visit type, availability, location, and distance. Paid provider plans change profile features, not organic ranking.

What the guide does not do

The guide does not diagnose, recommend a specific provider, replace professional care, or guarantee that a listed provider is appropriate for a particular person. Provider information can change, so visitors should confirm important details directly with the provider.
